mintAuthority.summary: MONEY has independent native crvUSD-style CDP issuance on Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism: users deposit approved collateral (WBTC, ETH, etc.) and mint MONEY against per-market debt ceilings using defi.money's controller/LLAMMA design; the defi.money admin Safe controls market onboarding and native risk parameters. LayerZero OFT transfer machinery is assessed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: defi.money market controllers (crvUSD-style minter)
controls.capDescription: On each reviewed native deployment, MONEY is minted only against overcollateralized loans in defi.money markets under per-market debt ceilings, using crvUSD's controller and LLAMMA soft-liquidation mechanics; supply tracks collateralized borrowing, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: The official defi.money deployment registry lists a MainController on Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism. defi.money docs describe a crvUSD-style loan/CDP stablecoin where users deposit approved collateral and borrow MONEY against per-market risk parameters with peg-keeper/LLAMMA mechanics on supported networks.

controls.label: defi.money admin Safe (MONEY token owner)
controls.capDescription: defi.money 3-of-7 Safe owns the MONEY token deployments and controls market onboarding, debt ceilings, and native risk parameters on the reviewed networks.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472419864, owner() on MONEY token returned 0x222d2B30EcD382a058618d9F1ee01F147666E48b. Safe API (arb1) confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2, threshold 3, 7 owners (0x3e254c20, 0x334deb1b, 0xCA88C5D4, 0x31dADb64, 0x86cf559f, 0xDeF1c4aD, 0xbADbABEF), no modules, no guard, nonce 6. EIP-1967 admin slot returned zero — not an upgradeable proxy. Direct Arbitrum RPC reads at block 472427523: getOwners() returned 7 owners, getThreshold()=3, getModulesPaginated empty, guard slot zero, masterCopy GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0. The reviewed Base and Optimism route observations found the same owner address on their same-address MONEY deployments; the Safe's native relevance is market onboarding and debt-ceiling/risk-parameter administration, while LayerZero bridge powers are separately authored under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472419864, owner() on MONEY token returned 0x222d2B30EcD382a058618d9F1ee01F147666E48b. Safe API confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2, 3-of-7 threshold, 7 owners, no modules, no guard. EIP-1967 admin slot zero (not upgradeable proxy). No minter() selector on token. The official defi.money deployment registry and reviewed MainController observations establish independent collateralized native issuance on Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism. The same Safe can authorize market controllers and raise native debt ceilings; LayerZero OFT bridge mint/burn and message validation are separate Bridge Risk machinery and are not counted as native Mint Authority. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the self-controlled 3-of-7 Safe can authorize controllers and raise caps without an independent delay, while current issuance is on-chain CDP collateral and no supervisor or attestor is evidenced.
